title: Hooks
description: Commands that run on this computer, as you, when something happens in a chat: before a tool runs, when a chat ends, and so on.
noFolder: Choose a folder above to see its hooks.
loadFailed: The hooks could not be read
unreadable.title: The hooks could not be shown
unreadable.body: The agent answered, but not in a form this page can show whole. Nothing is shown rather than part of the list.
session.title: The settings chat could not be opened
session.SCOPE: Pick one realm and a folder first.
session.NOT_READY: The agent on this computer is not signed in as you yet.
session.REFUSED: The agent would not open the settings chat.
session.UNKNOWN: The settings chat may not have opened. Try again; a chat left over closes itself.
session.BINDING: The settings chat opened somewhere other than expected and was closed.
session.LEASE: The settings chat could not be kept open and was closed.
session.LOST: The settings chat was lost twice.
session.SUPERSEDED: You moved to another place before the chat opened.
state.agentOff: Off: turned off by the agent
hidden.band: The agent turned off hooks whose command or matcher holds a {{what}} a screen does not show, so what you read would not be what runs. Each one is shown with that character marked as ⟨…⟩. Delete such a hook, then add it again typed in full.
event.Stop: When the agent finishes a turn
waiting: A change with an unknown outcome is waiting. Look at the list, then stop tracking it, first.
readonly.unplaced: The agent does not say which settings file declares this hook, so it cannot be changed here.
readonly.folder: This hook is saved for a folder. Choose that folder above to change it.
readonly.empty: A hook with no command cannot be named, and asking the agent to change it would reach every command in its group. It is shown, not changed.
readonly.long: This hook has a name too long to send whole, and a cut name could reach another hook. It is shown, not changed.
readonly.ascii: This hook's name has a character outside plain ASCII. The agent and this page can read such a name differently, so a change could reach another hook. It is shown, not changed.
readonly.twin: Another hook in this file has the same command and a name the agent takes for the same group, so a change to one would reach the other. It is shown, not changed.
readonly.short.unplaced: Its settings file is not known
readonly.short.empty: It has no command to name it by
readonly.short.long: Its name is too long to send whole
readonly.short.ascii: Its name has a non-ASCII character
readonly.short.twin: The agent cannot tell it from another hook
readonly.short.hidden: The agent turned it off for hidden characters: it can only be deleted
readonly.short.hiddenText: Its text holds a hidden character: it can only be deleted
readonly.short.whenBad: Its condition cannot be read: it can only be deleted
readonly.short.noPlace: The agent did not say where it is: update the agent to remove it
readonly.hiddenText: This hook's text holds a character a screen does not show, marked here as ⟨…⟩, so what you read is not what runs. It can only be deleted here: delete it, then add it again typed in full.
readonly.whenBad: This hook has a condition this page cannot read, so it cannot be checked for characters a screen does not show. It can only be deleted here.
readonly.noPlace: The agent turned off a hook here for hidden characters but did not say where it is in its file, so it cannot be removed from this page. Update the agent, then remove it here.
readonly.agent: The agent turned off a hook here for a reason this page does not know. It is shown, not changed.
empty.title: No hooks yet
empty.body: Nothing runs on its own in this place. Hooks you add here run on this computer, as you.
killed: All hooks are turned off in {{where}}. While the switch is on in a settings file, no hook runs in chats that read that file, wherever the hook is saved.
stale: Chats that are already open keep the hooks they started with. New chats use the list below.
trust.pending: These hooks are held until someone reviews them{{reason}}.
trust.unavailable: Whether these hooks are trusted cannot be checked right now{{reason}}.
dis.title: Disable all hooks?
dis.body: This turns on the switch for all hooks in {{where}}. While the switch is on in any settings file, no hook runs in chats that read that file, including hooks saved in other files and hooks that are on. Each hook keeps its own on or off state.
dis.bodyOn: This turns the switch for all hooks off in {{where}}. Hooks run again only if no other settings file still has the switch on, each as its own on or off state says.
del.title: Delete this hook?
del.effect: It stops running {{when}} and is removed from {{where}}.
del.hiddenRemoved: It is removed from {{where}}. The agent has turned it off, so it does not run.
del.effect2: The other hooks stay as they are.
del.hiddenEffect: Only the hook at this place in its settings file is removed, and only while its text is still exactly what is shown here. If the file changed since this list was read, nothing is removed.
done: The agent accepted the change. The list is read again.
held: Outcome unknown: a hook change ({{what}}) may have gone through. Check the list below, then stop tracking this change. Nothing is sent again.
stop.title: Stop tracking this change?
stop.effect: It may still have gone through. Nothing here can tell, so look at the list first.
refused.write_intent_invalid: The agent did not accept this request: its one-time permission had expired or been used. Nothing was changed. Try again.
refused.bad_request: The agent did not accept this change, so nothing was changed. Details says why.
refused.not_found: The agent could not find that hook, so nothing was changed. The list is read again.
notsent.TRUST_CHANGED: These hooks changed while you were reviewing them, so nothing was trusted. Review them again.
notsent.HOOKS_UNREADABLE: The hooks could not be read again before trusting them, so nothing was trusted.
notsent.NOT_EDITABLE: This hook can no longer be changed here. Nothing was sent.
notsent.SETTINGS_SCOPE: Pick one realm and a folder first. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_NOT_READY: The agent on this computer is not signed in as you yet. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_REFUSED: The agent would not open the settings chat. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_UNKNOWN: The settings chat may not have opened. Try again; a chat left over closes itself. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_BINDING: The settings chat opened somewhere other than expected and was closed. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_LEASE: The settings chat could not be kept open and was closed. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_LOST: The settings chat was lost twice. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_SUPERSEDED: You moved to another place before the chat opened. Nothing was changed.
when.unreadable: Has a condition this page cannot show: it stays as it is, but its event, tool or command cannot be changed here.
